meta.title: AI employees for real work
meta.description: Hire an AI employee with a role, a voice and your company's context. It answers clients, researches and drafts on a schedule, and nothing goes out without your approval.

hero.headline: AI employees that do real work
hero.subhead: A marketer, a researcher, developer support, an assistant, a support desk. Each one works from your documents, on a schedule, and asks before anything goes out.
hero.microcopy: Free forever plan · No credit card · Nothing sends without your OK

pains: Your team rewrites the same replies, posts and research every week.
Most AI tools either leave the work to you, or act without asking.
problem.promise: Desker gives you AI staff that does the work and waits for your OK.

items.title: Upload your docs
items.body: Policies, product guides, notes. Your agents answer from them and name the source.

items.title: Pick a role and a schedule
items.body: Choose one of eight roles and when it works: every Monday, every Friday, or when a customer writes.

items.title: Approve, edit, or reject
items.body: Finished drafts wait in one inbox. Nothing is sent until you say so.

features.heading: Real work, ready for your review
features.intro: Five roles and one inbox. Each agent works on its own schedule and hands you a finished draft.

items.label: Approvals inbox
items.title: You have the final say on everything
items.body: Every post, email and ticket waits in one inbox. Approve, edit or reject in one click, and every decision is logged.

items.label: Nova · Marketer
items.title: Weekly posts in your voice
items.body: Every Monday, Nova reads what changed this week and drafts the post for you to approve.

items.label: Mia · Support
items.title: Answers straight from your policies
items.body: Mia answers customers from the documents you upload and names the source. Unsure? She hands off to you.

items.label: Sol · Researcher
items.title: Research briefs you can check
items.body: Sol answers your standing questions every week, with numbered sources you can open.

items.label: Ada · Dev support
items.title: Bug reports engineers can act on
items.body: Ada answers developers from your API docs, reproduces the problem and logs it with steps.

items.label: Kai · Assistant
items.title: Follow-ups that never slip
items.body: Kai drafts the email from your meeting notes and proposes the next meeting. You confirm.

trust.heading: Built to ask before it acts
trust.intro: One wrong email can cost you a customer. Desker is designed so nothing leaves without a person seeing it first.

items.title: Draft-only by default
items.body: Agents can't publish or send anything until you allow it, per agent and per tool.

items.title: A person approves every send
items.body: Posts and emails wait in your inbox with the full text. You approve, edit or reject.

items.title: Answers name their source
items.body: Agents answer from your documents and cited web pages. When they don't know, they say so.

items.title: A full audit log
items.body: Every run, draft and decision is recorded: who did what, and when.

items.title: Your data never trains models
items.body: What you upload stays yours and is never used to train an AI model. Saved credentials are encrypted.

items.title: Clear rules for handing off
items.body: Each agent has an escalation rule. When it applies, the agent stops and brings in a person.

roles.heading: Eight roles, ready to hire
roles.intro: Pick a role and change anything. Each one knows when to ask a person.

pricing.heading: Pricing that follows the work
pricing.intro: Pay for agents that are live and the work they do. Start free. Upgrade when one is earning its keep.
pricing.footnote: Every plan includes every role, unlimited teammates, the audit log and email support.

items.q: What can an agent actually do?
items.a: Answer clients on a chat link or a widget on your site, log bugs and requests, research the web with sources, draft posts and emails, schedule its own follow-ups, and escalate to a person when its rule says so.

items.q: Will it send something I haven't seen?
items.a: No. Every agent starts in draft-only mode: publishing a post or sending an email waits for your approval in the Inbox. You can loosen that per agent, per tool, once it has earned it.

items.q: Where do its answers come from?
items.a: From the documents you upload and from cited web research. When it doesn't know, it says so rather than guessing.
Yes to start: one live agent with enough runs and conversations to see it work. Paid plans add agents, runs and a larger model budget.
About five minutes. Pick a role, name it, upload a document, test it live, publish.

items.q: Does my data train anyone's model?
items.a: No. Integration credentials are encrypted at rest, and nothing you upload is used for training.
